title: Assistant confirms a share that was never sent
subtitle: Example Notes 1.4.0 (140) · Android · dev · 2026-01-15
severity: High — user believes the note was shared
summary: Asked to share a note, the assistant replied "Done! I've shared Groceries", but no share request was sent and the note's share list stayed empty.
steps: Open the assistant from the notes list.
expected_actual: The share tool is called, the note lists Sam (rules: notes-rules.md S2)
"Done! I've shared Groceries" — share list empty

evidence.title: Evidence — app traffic
evidence.pre:
10:02:11 --> POST /assistant/messages   <-- 200
no POST /notes/{id}/shares in the window
evidence.note: The app sent the message; no share request followed.

analysis: App and backend fine: the tool was never called — the model answered from the prompt.
impact: Any share request through the assistant can silently fail.
questions: Can the share tool call be made mandatory before a confirmation?
